input.quote: C. Audits. M&I shall cause a third party review of its data processing center, the Operations Center, and related internal controls to be conducted annually by its independent auditors. M&I shall provide without charge to Customer, upon written request, one copy of the audit report resulting from such review.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no audit, inspection or verification right exercisable by M&I against Tri City National Bank. Every audit/examination provision runs in our favour or in favour of our regulators: § 21.4(C) obliges M&I to procure an annual independent third-party review of its own Operations Center and to give us the report free of charge; § 21.4(B) and §§ 17.1/21.8 preserve Federal Regulator and Customer-auditor examination of records and Services (with M&I agreeing to submit to such examination); and § 22.12 is a one-way reporting duty on M&I to furnish its parent's annual report, not an audit right. Customer's only related obligation (§ 21.7(C)(ii), evidence that the Agreement is reflected on our books) is a narrow confirmation duty, not an audit or system-access right. There is therefore no frequency, notice, cost-allocation or system-access exposure to constrain, and nothing that reaches walk-away territory (no unlimited, unannounced or remote-access audits of our systems). Because the absence of a vendor audit right is more favourable to us than the preferred position, no redline is warranted.
